subject: Fixed-form reference format
notes: kb/Work PB1491 + PB1359 + PB1492 landed: spaces at the end of the fixed-form continued line are part of the literal (program-text area read space-filled to margin R, DOC-A.1-157); the continuation line is the next non-comment non-blank line, for the fixed and the floating indicator; its first nonblank character is the matching quotation symbol (COBOL2684); a join that would SPELL a multiple-character separator, invocation operator or indicator split across lines is COBOL2688 (== and ::) / COBOL2496 (*> and >>).
